scope: Proposition 8.4 (Critical conditional-copy uniqueness) of the manuscript “The sharp factor-of-IID threshold for the free Ising model on regular trees” (preprints/The-sharp-factor-of-IID-threshold-for-the-free-Ising-model-on-regular-trees-September-26-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 236 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 aabb8cc15b9072c5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 45. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the invariant conditional coupling with common innovations at θ = b−1/2, the site-field discrepancy satisfies V (t) = 0 for every t ≥ 0.
